exercises.question: Which sentence connects a past change with the present? [¿Cuál conecta un cambio pasado con el presente?]
options: Hemos cambiado mucho desde que terminamos la universidad. [We have changed a lot since we finished university.]
Cambiábamos mucho cuando éramos niños. [We used to change a lot when we were children.]
Cambiaremos mucho el año próximo. [We will change a lot next year.]

exercises.sentence: Últimamente nos __ porque tenemos más tiempo para hablar. [Lately we have become closer because we have more time to talk.] (acercarse)

exercises.english: Our relationship has improved because we have learned to listen to each other.

sentences: Con los años hemos cambiado mucho. [Over the years we have changed a lot.]
También hemos aprendido a escucharnos. [We have also learned to listen to each other.]
Por eso nuestra relación ha mejorado. [That is why our relationship has improved.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: Entonces parece que estáis más unidos.

options: Nos hemos acercado porque hemos aprendido a escucharnos. [We have become closer because we have learned to listen to each other.]
Nos acercábamos porque aprenderemos a escucharnos. [We were becoming closer because we will learn to listen to each other.]
Nos acercamos ayer porque aprendíamos a escucharnos. [We became closer yesterday because we were learning to listen to each other.]

exercises.question: What does «nos hemos distanciado» mean? [¿Qué significa «nos hemos distanciado»?]
options: We have grown apart. [Nos hemos hecho más distantes.]
We used to meet. [Solíamos reunirnos.]
We have reconciled. [Nos hemos reconciliado.]

exercises.sentence: Nuestra relación __ mucho desde entonces. [Our relationship has changed a lot since then.] (cambiar)

exercises.english: Although we have grown somewhat distant, we still trust each other.

exercises.sentence: Hemos cambiado mucho desde que terminamos la universidad.
options: We have changed a lot since we finished university.
We used to change a lot when we were at university.
We will change a lot after university.

exercises.sentence: Últimamente nos hemos acercado porque tenemos más tiempo para hablar.

options: Nos hemos distanciado un poco, aunque seguimos confiando el uno en el otro. [We have grown somewhat distant, although we still trust each other.]
Nos distanciábamos ayer, aunque seguiremos confiando el uno en el otro. [We were growing apart yesterday, although we will continue trusting each other.]
Nos distanciamos todos los días desde mañana. [We grow apart every day from tomorrow.]

exercises.question: Which time expression commonly works with the present perfect to describe recent change? [¿Cuál encaja con el pretérito perfecto para un cambio reciente?]
options: Últimamente [Lately]
Cada domingo cuando era niño [Every Sunday when I was a child]
El año 2010 [The year 2010]

exercises.sentence: Hemos __ mucho en los últimos años. [We have changed a lot in recent years.] (cambiar)

template.prompt: Describe one way a relationship has changed.
template.answer: Nuestra relación ha mejorado porque hemos aprendido a escucharnos.

template.prompt: Describe a recent increase in closeness.
template.answer: Últimamente nos hemos acercado porque hablamos más.

template.prompt: Describe a relationship that has become more distant but remains positive.
template.answer: Nos hemos distanciado un poco, pero seguimos confiando el uno en el otro.

template.prompt: Explain what has caused a change.
template.answer: Hemos cambiado porque nuestras vidas han seguido caminos diferentes.

exercises.question: Choose the sentence that describes a change relevant now. [Elige la frase que describe un cambio relevante ahora.]
options: Nuestra relación ha mejorado desde que hablamos más. [Our relationship has improved since we started talking more.]
Nuestra relación mejoraba todos los domingos. [Our relationship used to improve every Sunday.]
Nuestra relación mejorará el año que viene. [Our relationship will improve next year.]
